introduction.value: A commenter uses Claude to build a targeted job description and resume as a starting point for job applications.

method.value: The poster set up a job-search workspace for Claude Cowork or Claude Code with resumes and cover-letters folders, plus sample past documents and a CLAUDE.md file describing their background, style, and rules. outcome.value: The source presents this as a useful personal workflow, not a measured experiment, so it gives no counts on applications or interviews. A commenter says the outputs still need review because Claude can hallucinate or oversell experience.

Draft targeted resumes and job descriptions for applications
A commenter uses Claude to build a targeted job description and resume as a starting point for job applications.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The poster set up a job-search workspace for Claude Cowork or Claude Code with resumes and cover-letters folders, plus sample past documents and a CLAUDE.md file describing their background, style, and rules. When they paste in a job description, Claude analyzes the role, drafts a targeted resume and cover letter as .docx files, saves them into those folders, summarizes how it tailored them, and flags gaps or asks questions instead of guessing.
How it went
The source presents this as a useful personal workflow, not a measured experiment, so it gives no counts on applications or interviews. A commenter says the outputs still need review because Claude can hallucinate or oversell experience.
Worth knowing
The main catch is setup quality: the poster says to provide detailed achievements and real numbers, and to review the drafts rather than sending them unchanged.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Here is the job posting I'm interested in: [paste or link]. Here is my current resume and background: [file or notes]. Write a targeted job description summary of what the employer wants, then draft a tailored resume in a new file as a starting point, without inventing experience I don't have. Flag any gaps for me to review.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/claude/comments/1slfug5/useful_workflow_for_claude_code_or_cowork_for_job
